digest.component_or_area: LLM provider initialization and resource management
propositions: Provider construction logic is currently inlined in runner.py:268 with anthropic-specific branching, requiring new branches for each additional provider (Bedrock, OpenAI-compatible)
Provider teardown (httpx.AsyncClient closure) is handled ad-hoc in runner.py:446-452 finally block with no generalized resource lifecycle pattern
A ProviderSession abstraction should own provider construction via a registry-backed factory callable and manage client lifecycle through context manager teardown
The anthropic provider builder should move verbatim into providers.py while preserving existing retry transport, max_retries=0 guard, and per-request timeout behavior
Imports of _build_retrying_anthropic_model in test files must be updated from rebar.llm.runner to rebar.llm.anthropic_model to reflect the module relocation
